title: Expansion Associate (H/F) - 100%
description:
Tu n'abandonnes pas au premier refus, ni au dixième. Tu traites une liste le vendredi après-midi avec le même soin que le lundi matin, et tu mènes à terme ce que tu as commencé, pour que rien ne reste en suspens et que rien ne vieillisse en silence dans un coin. Tu n'as besoin de personne derrière ton épaule pour tenir ton niveau d'exigence. Et quand un cas ne rentre pas dans le processus, tu le signales au lieu de bricoler une solution.

Si tu te reconnais dans ces lignes, tu es au bon endroit.

En tant qu'Expansion Associate, tu es le chasseur ou la chasseuse d'appartements de Room Estate en Suisse romande, avec un accent sur Genève. Tu es responsable de l'acquisition d'appartements de A à Z : tu passes le marché au crible, tu évalues chaque appartement sous l'angle du coliving, tu le visites sur place, tu postules en notre nom, tu relances et tu accompagnes le dossier jusqu'à la signature du bail. C'est un rôle pour les personnes qui passent à l'action, et c'est précisément sa force : fréquence, ténacité et sens des responsabilités dans un processus clairement défini. Notre principe directeur : la croissance naît d'un tri des annonces à haute fréquence, d'une évaluation rigoureuse et de relances systématiques, pas de coups de chance. Tu travailles en étroite collaboration avec notre responsable de l'équipe Acquisition, qui tranche les cas d'appréciation, et ton travail se mesure à ce qui compte au final : les chambres acquises, les baux signés et la qualité de ce que tu ramènes.

Tasks

  • Tu passes les portails immobiliers au crible de manière systématique, chaque jour et avec un regard sûr pour ce qui convient.

  • Tu évalues chaque appartement sous l'angle du coliving : plan, état, immeuble, et la question de savoir si la propriété est prête à jouer le jeu.

  • Tu organises les visites et tu te rends sur place pour vérifier sur l'objet réel ce que promet l'annonce.

  • Tu postules en notre nom et tu positionnes Room Estate comme le locataire que toute régie souhaite avoir.

  • Tu relances jusqu'à ce qu'une décision soit prise. Aucun dossier ne s'enlise.

  • Tu accompagnes le dossier jusqu'à la signature et tu contrôles le bail à l'aide de notre liste de contrôle : points critiques, clauses manquantes et écarts par rapport à l'annonce.

  • Tu tiens le suivi des dossiers à jour : chaque objet saisi, chaque statut traçable.

Requirements

  • Sens des responsabilités et autonomie. Tu fais avancer un processus de bout en bout à une fréquence élevée et à un rythme fiable, tu vas au bout de chaque suivi et tu ne laisses aucun dossier s'enliser. C'est le cœur de ce rôle.

  • Maîtrise du français, à l'écrit comme à l'oral, dans les échanges avec les régies et les propriétaires.

  • Ténacité et sens de la négociation, le marché locatif genevois dit souvent non, et cela ne te déstabilise pas.

  • Un œil pour les plans, tu vois d'emblée si le coliving fonctionne dans un appartement et combien de chambres sont réalistes.

  • Rigueur dans le travail avec des listes de contrôle, tu vas au bout de chaque point plutôt que de faire les choses à peu près, et tu repères les écarts. Aucune connaissance spécialisée en droit du bail n'est requise.

  • Permis de conduire catégorie B et disponibilité pour des visites régulières à Genève, dans la région lémanique et dans le reste de la Suisse romande.

  • Anglais courant, à l'écrit comme à l'oral, notre langue de travail interne.

BONUS

  • Expérience dans le secteur immobilier suisse (formation en gérance immobilière, cours USPI, activité de courtage)

  • Réseau existant auprès des régies et des propriétaires à Genève et dans la région lémanique

  • Expérience dans l'univers du coliving ou des appartements meublés avec services

  • Connaissances de base du droit du bail suisse

  • Allemand

Benefits

  • Salaire fixe plus bonus progressif pour chaque chambre acquise, sans plafond : plus tu acquiers de chambres, plus tu gagnes par chambre.

  • Bureau à Lausanne, avec la possibilité de télétravailler certains jours

  • Équipement de ton choix (ordinateur portable, écran, accessoires)

  • Des processus et des listes de contrôle documentés, et un·e responsable d'équipe à qui reviennent les exceptions, pour que tu puisses faire ta part avec précision au lieu d'improviser

  • Un rôle qui t'appartient : tu ne fais pas partie d'une équipe d'acquisition, tu es l'acquisition en Suisse romande

  • Une équipe internationale et solidaire, avec une vraie culture de l'apprentissage

  • Budget de formation continue (cours, livres, conférences)

  • Une vraie évolution : ton ambition détermine jusqu'où tu iras, tes résultats à quelle vitesse. Ton périmètre de responsabilité grandit avec les deux.

Chez Room Estate, tu bénéficies de vraies responsabilités et d'un feedback direct, sans micromanagement ni langue de bois. On se tutoie, on se dit les choses, et nous sommes exigeants : tu as le droit de l'être tout autant avec nous.

Des séminaires d'équipe, une fête d'été annuelle et une collaboration étroite avec des collègues de différents pays font partie de l'aventure et élargissent ton réseau personnel et professionnel. Mais l'essentiel est simple : nous voulons progresser chaque jour et nous cherchons des personnes qui le veulent aussi. Ici, tu assumes un rôle qui compte, dans un environnement international, et tu contribues activement à façonner l'avenir du coliving en Europe.

title: MSF International Managing Director
description:
Location: Based in Geneva or within approximately +/- two (2) hours from Geneva

Contract: Fixed term at 100% - It is a mandated role (currently 3+3 years)

Starting date: 01st of March 2027

Deadline to apply: 26th of November 2026 - We reserve the right to close this position once suitable candidates have been identified.

Compensation and Benefits: MSF practice is to offer the compensation and benefits package in line with the MSF entity offering the contract

*By default, the successful candidate will be offered a contract in the MSF office, able to issue a contract, of their country of residence at the time of application. If no MSF office exists in their country of residence, the successful candidate will be expected to relocate to a country where an MSF office can issue a contract, provided the local legislation allows for that.

At MSF, we are committed to an inclusive culture that encourages and supports the diverse voices of our employees. We welcome applications from individuals of all genders, ages, sexual orientations, nationalities, races, religions, beliefs, ability status, and all other diversity characteristics.

MSF is committed to preventing abuse, inappropriate behaviour, lack of integrity and financial misconduct in its work and care spaces. The successful candidate will be expected to comply with the organisation’s safeguarding policies and standards of professional behaviour.

We are committed to removing barriers for people with specific accessibility needs. If you need an adjustment to the recruitment process to be considered for the role, please let us know from the beginning of the selection process.

MSF International

Médecins Sans Frontières (MSF) is an international, independent, medical humanitarian organisation that delivers emergency aid to people affected by armed conflict, epidemics, healthcare exclusion and natural disasters. MSF offers assistance to people based only on need and irrespective of race, religion, gender or political affiliation. MSF International is the legal entity that binds MSF’s 26 sections, 28 associations and 16 branch offices together. Registered in Switzerland, MSF International provides coordination, information and support to the MSF Movement, as well as implements international projects and initiatives as requested.

I. CONTEXT

Médecins Sans Frontières (MSF) is an international, independent medical humanitarian organisation providing emergency assistance to people affected by armed conflict, epidemics, healthcare exclusion and natural disasters, based solely on need and irrespective of race, religion, gender or political affiliation.

MSF International is the legal entity whose membership is composed of all MSF associations. It hosts the International Secretariat, supports the International Board, facilitates coordination across the MSF movement, and provides shared services and initiatives as mandated by the movement.

Within MSF International, the International Office acts as the Secretariat of the International Board (IB) and operates under the direct management of the International Secretary General (ISG). MSF International also provides administrative and operational support to movement-wide initiatives and services, including MSF Access.

II. PURPOSE OF THE JOB

The MSF International Managing Director is a senior executive role responsible for institutional leadership, stewardship of resources, and organizational performance of MSF International as a legal entity serving the MSF movement.

The role ensures that MSF International:

  • Effectively implements -within the scope of MSF International - the MSF International Multiyear Plan and SPARC (MSF-wide Strategic Planning, Accountability and Resource Cycle) and supports the International Board and the International Secretary General in their governance roles and responsibilities.

  • Provides high quality, well governed services to the MSF movement, as mandated by the Full ExCom (executive committee);

  • Operates with strong systems of governance, accountability, risk management and duty of care;

  • Has robust, transparent and efficient governance, financial, human, and knowledge systems;

  • Operates as a coherent, inclusive, and accountable internationally distributed organization;

  • Models MSF values in leadership, equity, duty of care, and ethical management;

  • Ensures that the decisions taken by the Board of Directors of MSF International and its implementation is compliant with the Articles of Association, the internal regulations, as well as Swiss standards and Swiss laws, for as long as the registered office is in Geneva, Switzerland.

The MSF Management Director acts as a strategic partner to the International Secretary General, providing leadership on transversal and institutional topics with regards to the management of MSF International.

III. ACCOUNTABILITIES

1. Strategic Leadership and Implementation of MSF International (Multi‑year Plan & SPARC): Lead the translation of MSF International and movement strategic priorities into clear objectives, organisational plans, policies and resourcing within MSF International; support cross‑functional initiatives required by international platforms as needed to deliver the Multi‑Year Strategic Plan and SPARC commitments.

Expected result: MSF International delivers on agreed strategic priorities and SPARC commitments through coherent plans, measurable milestones and coordinated delivery across functions and movement partners.

a. Contribute to the development of MSF International Multi‑year Strategic Plan and SPARC within MSF International’s mandate and scope and translate strategic priorities into concrete organisational objectives, policies, systems and resource allocations, ensuring coherence across functions and services.

b. Supports cross‑functional and transversal initiatives required to deliver common strategic priorities and SPARC‑related commitments.

c. Contribute to movement-wide discussions on harmonization, efficiency and shared services.

d. Sets up and tracks implementation plans, including key milestones, indicators, and risks. Support the ISG in reporting to the International Board and relevant Standing Committees, and contribute to SPARC’s Monitoring & Evaluation Framework and Expense Steering Process for functions and services managed within MSF International’s scope.

e. Deputize for the ISG as required, within agreed scope and representation mandates.

f. Represent MSF International to key stakeholders, partners and external audiences as required, and build relationships that protect and advance MSF's institutional interests.

2. Governance, legal compliance, accountability and risk management for MSF-International: Ensure robust governance implementation, statutory compliance and effective risk management systems for MSF International as a Swiss legal entity and for services delivered on behalf of the movement; prepare governance-level advice and support Board decision-making.

Expected result: International Board and executive decisions are supported by timely, compliant and risk‑informed advice; MSF International statutory obligations and legal requirements are met and organisational risks are identified and mitigated.

a. Act as senior management liaison to the ISG, the International Board and Standing Committees on matters related to MSF International organisational governance, resources, risk, compliance and organisational performance.

b. Ensure robust systems of internal control, risk management and accountability, are in place and functioning for MSF International, in line with legal, fiduciary and associative obligations, including preparedness for critical incidents directly affecting MSF International.

c. Lead or support organizational responses to critical incidents directly affecting MSF International, including HR, legal, reputational, safeguarding or security‑related situations.

d. Ensure that MSF International fulfils its statutory responsibilities as a Swiss legal entity and that appropriate legal, administrative and governance support is obtained for decisions of the IB in light of the International Statutes, the Internal Regulations, and Swiss standards and law. Ensure compliance with applicable laws and regulations regarding daily management of MSF International.

e. Oversee compliance with GDPR and Swiss data protection law, promoting a culture of privacy and responsible data use.

f. Ensure appropriate legal review of all contracts and agreements directly involving MSF International and including those through which it delivers services to the movement, in accordance with MSF’s rules and policies, as well as Swiss law.

g. Design, implement and monitor the effectiveness of internal control systems and procedures; ensure that MSF International risks are identified and registered and ensure that mitigation measures are discussed and incorporated in the respective departments annual plans.

3. Services to MSF: Provide executive stewardship of movement-wide services mandated to MSF International, ensuring clear service governance, defined accountabilities and cost‑effective delivery.

Expected result: Movement services operate to agreed service charters and KPIs, with transparent costs and reliable delivery that meet sections' needs and contractual obligations.

a. Provide executive leadership and stewardship over services mandated to MSF International in support of the MSF movement, ensuring they are clearly governed, fit for purpose, cost‑effective and appropriately funded.

b. Ensure that roles, responsibilities, decision‑making authority and service boundaries between MSF International and MSF sections are clearly defined and communicated, balancing interoperability and mutualization objectives with the sections and ODs autonomy.

c. Establish and monitor service governance and performance frameworks, including service charters, KPIs, cost‑sharing arrangements and escalation mechanisms where relevant, and ensure transparency.

d. Facilitate structured dialogue with MSF sections to identify service needs, manage expectations and address risks or performance issues.

4. Financial stewardship and institutional integrity: Oversee budgeting, financial planning, statutory accounts, audits and financial controls; ensure alignment of resources with strategic priorities and manage institutional financial and insurance arrangements.

Expected result: MSF International maintains sound financial health, regulatory compliance and transparent resource allocation that supports strategic objectives.

a. Provide executive oversight of budgeting, forecasting and financial reporting for MSF International.

b. Ensure alignment between strategic priorities (including SPARC) and resource allocation.

c. Oversee statutory accounts, audits, financial policies and compliance with Swiss GAAP, tax and VAT requirements.

d. Oversee relationships with external auditors, financial advisors and legal counsel.

e. Oversee institutional insurance coverage and financial risk mitigation. Manage the full suite of institutional and corporate insurance coverage for MSF International.

f. Oversee legacies and donations earmarked for MSF International

5. People, culture and organisational development: Oversee people strategy, workforce planning, performance management, leadership development and organisational design to foster an inclusive, safe and high‑performing culture across a distributed workforce.

Expected result: A diverse, supported and capable organisation with clear succession pathways, strong performance management and a positive organisational culture.

a. Provide strategic leadership over human resources management, organizational design and workforce planning.

b. Ensure a safe, supportive, inclusive, equitable, diverse, respectful, and healthy workplace, free from abuse and other misconduct.

c. Oversee performance management, leadership development and succession planning.

d. Ensure a lively MSF International culture despite the geographical spread, including through adequate internal communication.

e. Lead organisational development, when necessary, to ensure the organisational structure remains fit for purpose and appropriate for a well-functioning office.

f. Manage institutional relationships with MSF sections hosting MSF International staff and ensure coherent frameworks for hosting, contracting, payroll and staff integration.

g. Ensure appropriate information governance and that knowledge management systems support collaboration, institutional memory and organizational learning, including learning from strategy and SPARC implementation.

h. Liaise regularly with the Staff Committee of MSF International.

IV. AUTONOMY, COMPLEXITY

The MSF International Managing Director operates with a high degree of autonomy to think, interpret and act within the strategic direction set by the International Secretary General, the International Board and the governance framework of MSF International.

The role is required to make independent judgements on organisational priorities, resource allocation, risk mitigation, service performance, people matters and operational responses, often in situations where issues are sensitive, cross-functional and without straightforward precedent.

The complexity of the environment is significant: the postholder works across a federated MSF movement with multiple stakeholders, distributed teams, hosted staff arrangements and diverse section interests, while also ensuring compliance with Swiss legal and regulatory requirements, internal governance rules, financial and HR procedures, safeguarding standards and data protection obligations. Success therefore depends on balancing institutional coherence, legal and procedural rigour, and service effectiveness with diplomacy, sound judgement and the ability to operate in ambiguity.

V. SAFEGUARDING REQUIREMENTS FOR THE ROLE

The incumbent commits to contribute to a safe, supportive, inclusive, equitable, diverse, respectful, and healthy workplace, free from abuse and other misconduct. They will not engage in any form of abuse including those detailed in MSF Typologies of Abuse and when an employee suspects or observes abuse, they will report it (without investigating it) to protect others.

  • Ensure respectful management and communication at all levels.

  • Ensure that staff and consultants under their supervision understand their responsibilities with respect to required behaviour and report abuse while working for MSF by reinforcing and regularly discussing expected standards of behaviour.

  • Welcome complainants, understand how to guide colleagues to appropriate channels, promote and create an environment that does not tolerate abuse or inappropriate behaviour. Guide colleagues to the correct process without investigating.

  • Ensure that staff know how to complain and keep staff updated on reporting mechanisms.


Education

  • Master’s degree in management, humanitarian affairs, political sciences, or a related field, or equivalent senior-level professional experience

Experience

  • Extensive senior leadership experience (General/Executive Director, Deputy Director or Director of a major organizational function) in a complex and large international and decentralised organisations

  • MSF experience is a major asset

  • Proven ability to operate at Board and executive level

  • Strong people leadership, including conflict management and change leadership

  • Solid expertise in financial oversight, governance and organisational systems

  • Experience with equity, diversity and inclusion strategies

Knowledge

  • Strong commitment to MSF’s humanitarian principles and associative values.

  • High level of integrity and ability to handle confidential and sensitive matters.

  • Knowledge of Swiss legal, institutional, employment, financial and data protection frameworks is an asset.

  • Familiarity with governance of associations and federated movements is an asset.

  • Proven ability to lead cross-functional and institutional change.

  • Comfortable leading teams across different locations and liaising with stakeholders at all levels.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication, able to communicate complex or sensitive matters clearly, concisely, and professionally.

  • High level of discretion, judgement, and emotional intelligence, and the ability to build a strong network across an organisation.

  • Confident decision‑making and the ability to act autonomously as appropriate.

  • Flexible team player, willing to adapt to changes, and confident tackling unfamiliar challenges across multiple domains of knowledge/experience.

Languages

  • Excellent English (written and spoken) is essential.

  • French highly desirable, and other MSF languages are further assets.

Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

title: Senior RAM Engineer
description:
Destinus Engineering is looking for a highly motivated and experienced Senior Reliability Engineer to ensure that our defense systems and products perform dependably in demanding operational environments. You’ll lead reliability, availability and maintainability (RAM) efforts across Destinus systems and products covering the full product lifecycle, from early design trade studies through qualification, fielding, and sustainment. You will work closely with system design, test, and supply chain teams as well as customers. The ideal candidate is a strong team player with good social and leadership skills to continuously coordinate with the peers of the respective engineering disciplines and teams.

Key Responsibilities

· Develop and execute reliability program plans in line with contract requirements and applicable standards (e.g., MIL-STD-785, MIL-HDBK-217, MIL-STD-1629, IEC 60812, FIDES, ANSI/GEIA-STD-0009, ASD S3000L or customer-specific equivalents)

· Perform reliability predictions, FMEA/FMECA, fault tree analysis, derating and worst-case analyses, and reliability block diagram modeling

· Define and run reliability test programs, including HALT/HASS, environmental stress screening, accelerated life testing, and reliability growth testing

· Contribute to design reviews (PDR, CDR) and influence design for reliability and maintainability early in development

· Support sustainment engineering, including obsolescence and parts-quality assessments, and supplier reliability oversight

· Prepare reliability documentation and present findings to internal leadership and government customers

· Availability modelling and allocating RAM requirements down from the system to subsystems

· Maintainability analysis plus testability and BIT coverage analysis

· Input to the maintenance and logistic support analysis, working with ILS

Requirements

Required Qualifications

· BSc or MSc in engineering (electrical, mechanical, systems, or related)

· [7+] years of reliability engineering experience preferably in the defense sector

· Experience in a tier 1 defense supplier company interacting directly with the military customer is a plus

· Hands-on experience with FMEA/FMECA, reliability prediction, and statistical life data analysis

· Experience with Air Defence and / or Strike systems is a plus

· Experience with modern European RAM standards: IEC 60812, FIDES, ANSI/GEIA-STD-0009, ASD S3000L

· Familiarity with military reliability and environmental standards (e.g., MIL-STD-810, MIL-STD-461) and DoD acquisition or equivalent processes

· Experience using RWB Isograph or similar RAMS software.

· Proactive, ownership-driven mindset with strong problem-solving capabilities

· Ability to work autonomously and as part of a fast-paced, dynamic, international and multidisciplinary development team.

· Fluency in English is required; German is a plus.

title: Mechanical Engineer, Jigs & Tools
description:
About the Role

The Destinus engineering team is looking for a highly motivated and hands-on mechanical engineer capable of delivering jigs and tooling solutions as part of the research and development in the rocket motor department. In this role, you will design and develop equipment and machines for testing and production of our products. The ideal candidate will have at least 3 years of experience as a mechanical engineer with experience in industrialization projects, mechanical design and DFM with a demonstrated ability to take ownership during development and drive technical solutions.

Responsibilities

  • Take the technical lead for the Jigs and Tools development
  • Review product designs from a production point of view
  • Understand and evaluate the production steps and the needed tools
  • Research existing off-the-shelf components and combine them to a production solution
  • Generate 3D CAD models, drawings, bills of material, and other related documentation required for production.
  • Deliver technical documentation including any engineering calculations, analysis and assumptions required to substantiate your design decisions and solutions.
  • Manage suppliers and manufacturers by addressing any technical questions and resolving any issues which may arise during the manufacturing process.
  • Select standard parts, fasteners, equipment, and consumables following best practices and industry standards.
  • Coach junior engineers and interns in jigs and tooling design, manufacturing and CAD.
  • Participate in design reviews and technical discussions during different development stages.
  • Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams, including mechanical, testing, and industrialization engineers, to ensure seamless integration and functionality of the components into the vehicle.

Requirements

Qualifications and Experience

  • BSc. In Mechanical Engineering, Design Engineering or a related discipline.
  • Ideally, technical training as a mechanical designer/drafter, Toolmaker or Mechanic
  • Min. 3 years of experience in mechanical engineering with close ties to jigs & tools for production
  • Knowledge of machining, sheet metal, composites and assembly processes, and of metrology and inspection methods.
  • Lean manufacturing knowledge is desirable.
  • Experience with 3D printing for tooling is a plus.
  • Experience with design of automated solutions, special machines or test benches is a benefit
  • Ideally, experience in several different phases: design, build, integration, test, and operation.
  • Good communication skills, proactive attitude, and problem-solving skills.
  • The ability to work to strict timescales as part of an integrated, multidisciplinary team and autonomously.
  • The ability and willingness to thrive in a fast-paced, rapidly changing work environment.
  • Willingness to travel to different Destinus sites in Switzerland (max. 20%)
  • Fluency in English and German language is required.

title: Compliance Officer / MLRO Switzerland & Liechtenstein
description:
Compliance Officer / MLRO - Switzerland & Liechtenstein

 

About Keyrock

 

Since 2017, Keyrock has been a change-maker in digital assets. We're a global, remote-first team of 180+ people across 40+ nationalities, with hubs in Brussels, London, Paris, New York and Chicago.

We provide liquidity across 80+ centralized and decentralized exchanges - a position cemented by our Series C, led by SC Ventures. Today we run a full spectrum of capital markets businesses across centralized and on-chain venues: market making, high-frequency trading, options, OTC, DeFi trading desks, advisory, and asset management.

We're building toward the agentic investment banking capabilities for the era of digital finance. A proprietary agentic layer runs the mechanics of the market, so our people can focus on the work code cannot do: the deal, the relationship, and the judgement.

 

We're not just envisioning the future of finance - we're building it.

 

Mission statement

We are looking for an experienced and driven Compliance Officer and MLRO for our Switzerland and Liechtenstein based entities. You will join a dynamic and dedicated Group Compliance team, operating as a key member while focusing primarily on our Switzerland and Liechtenstein operational entities. This role offers an exciting opportunity to make a wider impact across the organization by working on broader, group-level projects, allowing you to contribute to the global compliance framework and help grow the group as a whole.

 

Job description

 

  • Ensuring compliance with all relevant laws and regulations applicable to Switzerland and Liechtenstein by developing and implementing the policies and procedures ;

  • Conducting compliance risk assessments and elaborating an annual compliance plan;

  • Developing and implementing a plan of second-line controls and conducting the tests;

  • Assessing future business activities to identify potential compliance risks;

  • Ensuring the firm’s policies and procedures are being communicated effectively to all relevant employees;

  • Ensuring the compliance trainings are effective and up to date;

  • Keeping abreast with regulatory changes and maintaining the policies and procedures up to date;

  • Collaborate with internal departments such as Trading Operations, Finance, Risk management, IT & Security, etc… to integrate compliance requirements into business processes.

  • Being responsible for oversight of Keyrock CH and LI compliance with its AML obligations and acting as a focal point for the firm’s AML activity (MLRO).

  • Carrying out the duties of a MLRO as per the AML/CTF Framework

  • Representing Keyrock CH and LI in all matters of money laundering prevention internally and externally;

  • Serving as a subject matter expert on AML/CTF matters, providing guidance and support to the compliance team and other departments;

  • Conducting regular audits and reviews to ensure compliance with AML/CTF requirements and internal policies

  • Drafting of compliance points of attention and recommendations and assisting the Group Head of Compliance or Group General Counsel (Group level) with management information reports;

 

Background and experience

  • Solid experience as a Compliance officer (2nd line of defense) in a regulated financial institution in Switzerland and/or Liechtenstein, ideally with exposure to MLRO responsibilities or similar

  • Experience in engaging with Swiss and Liechtenstein regulatory authorities;

  • Excellent knowledge of financial regulations such as MiCAR, AML/CTF, market abuse , data privacy;

  • Understanding of the digital assets ecosystem is a major plus;

  • A relevant degree, preferably in business or law, is required;

  • Extensive experience in implementation of monitoring and control processes to support policies and procedures;

  • A compliance qualification for example ACAMS or a Masters in a related field would be an advantage;

 

Our recruitment philosophy

We look for self-aware candidates who bring both the core skills required for the role and a deep alignment with our performance principles. We seek fiercely passionate, mission-driven people who communicate with purpose and practice proactive ownership. The perfect fit? A crypto enthusiast who prioritizes mission over ego, maintains a commercial mindset, and delivers long-term value through pragmatic flexibility.

Our offer

 

  • A competitive salary and benefits package

  • Annual Team Retreats: a yearly offsite dedicated to strategy, celebration of our wins and fun team activities

  • Opportunity to work remotely

  • Fast-paced, highly intellectually stimulating working environment

  • The freedom to create your own entrepreneurial experience by being part of a team of people in search of excellence

 

As an employer we are committed to building a positive and collaborative work environment. We welcome employees of all backgrounds, and hire, reward and promote entirely based on merit and performance.

 

Due to the nature of our business and external requirements, we perform background checks on all potential employees, passing which is a prerequisite to join Keyrock.

title: Senior Solutions Architect
System Identification Engineer
description:
About Us

Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.

Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected.

About the role

Every airframe Harmattan AI flies starts with a model. System identification turns flight data into the verified dynamics that guidance and control are designed, tuned and trained on. It is the foundation of an autopilot that adapts across multirotors, fixed wings, VTOLs and missiles.

As a System Identification Engineer, working out of Lausanne, you will own the path from flight test to identified model. You will design and run your own experiments, build a repeatable identification pipeline, and deliver models the G&C team can trust.

 
 

Responsibilities

  • Experiment Design & Flight Test: Plan and run your own identification tests, from excitation design to flight tests, including coordinating with the .

  • Model Identification: Identify rigid-body, aerodynamic, propulsion and actuator dynamics using frequency and time-domain methods, including closed-loop identification on vehicles flown under a controller.

  • Propulsion & Actuators: Characterize motors, ESCs, propellers and control surfaces, including bandwidth, delays, saturation, and thermal and battery effects.

  • Identification Pipeline: Build and maintain an automated, reproducible pipeline from flight logs to identified model. This covers ingestion, data-quality checks, estimation, validation and reporting.

  • Model Validation: Validate models against held-out flight data, quantify uncertainty, and make sure each model is fit for purpose: controller design, simulation, or training learned G&C.

  • New Airframes: Extend the capability from multirotors to control-surface multirotors, fixed wings, tail-sitters and missiles.

  • Simulation & G&C Support: Deliver models into simulation, SITL and HITL, and work closely with control, guidance and embedded engineers to close the loop between models and flight results.

  • Mentorship: Depending on seniority, support the team by mentoring junior engineers and interns.

 
 

Candidate Requirements

  • Educational Background: A strong academic record with a degree in aerospace, control, mechanical engineering or a related STEM field. A practical track record matters more than the specific degree.

  • System Identification: Proven experience identifying dynamic models of flying platforms from real data, in both the frequency and time domain, including the pitfalls of closed-loop data.

  • Flight Mechanics & Control: Solid grasp of rigid-body dynamics, aerodynamic forces and moments, non-dimensionalization, stability modes and propulsion models. Also enough control background to know what the model will be used for.

  • Flight Testing: Hands-on experience planning and running flight tests and working from raw, imperfect logs.

  • Software: Strong Python and scientific computing skills, with the discipline to build tools others can rerun.

 

Nice to have

  • Rigorous about data quality, uncertainty and validation; skeptical of models until they are proven.

  • Autonomous and hands-on, comfortable moving between bench, field and code.

  • Communicates clearly, able to present models and test results to engineers and senior stakeholders.

  • Thrives under pressure in a fast-paced environment with a no-task-is-too-small mentality.

  • Fixed-wing aerodynamic modeling; VTOL or tail-sitter dynamics; remote pilot certification; experience with real flight logs; structural or vibration modes; data-driven or learned dynamics models.

  • Commitment: 100% dedication to Harmattan AI’s mission of providing a defensive edge to allied nations through ethical, high-impact technology.

We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.

Our software moves energy usage to times when electricity is cheap and green, by controlling vehicle charging, heating systems, and home batteries. We control hundreds of thousands of energy assets.

We’re building in a legacy industry and moving gigawatt-hours of electrons in the real world, but we operate at lightning speed, and we’re growing the team to meet customer demand.

We’re proud to be supported by world-leading investors, including Energize Capital and Accel.

Read more about what we’re building here.

We’re looking for a commercially sharp, highly autonomous operator to drive Axle’s commercial success in the Dutch market.

Axle has quickly become the leader in our operational markets, and we’re now looking to expand our reach internationally. Our goal is to become the go-to platform for energy flexibility globally, and we’re hiring the person to make that happen.

This role will assess Axle’s participation in Dutch markets and business models from first principles: diving deep into regulations, modelling revenue-per-asset, and trialling new propositions at pace.

You speak Dutch and fluent English. Other European languages will also be an asset.

What you will be doing

  • Owning Axle’s commercial results in the Dutch market: pipeline, revenue and partner success

  • Winning new customers end-to-end, from first conversation through to commercial close, and setting partners up to generate meaningful revenue

  • Driving go-to-market execution with partners, including value propositions, pricing, customer segmentation and launch strategy

  • Building the zero-to-one of the business through partnerships. You’ll be on the phone (and eventually on the ground) with utilities/retailers, potential clients and grid operators, creating and disproving hypotheses as quickly as possible

  • Continuing to sharpen our view of where the value is and which markets and business models are accessible to us

title: Junior or Medior AI Engineer

HelloPrint is rebuilding the entire platform: new frontend, new pricing engine, new content engine, new product engine, everything ready for an agentic future. No one on the team writes code manually for what these systems handle. You'll work inside this rebuild, under the direction of our founding team (Hans, CEO, and Michael, CIO/Chief AI Officer), executing on high-leverage AI problems with real commercial impact, visible immediately in revenue or cost. There's no management layer between you and the outcome. You build, you ship, you measure, you move to the next problem.

What you will build:

The opportunity surface is large: 14 markets, 600,000 customers, a platform being rebuilt in parallel across four core engines. You'll work on problems from areas like:

  • Dynamic pricing and margin optimization across markets.

  • Agentic procurement: supplier selection, ordering, quality management.

  • Customer journey automation from configuration to post-delivery.

  • Intelligent content and SEO infrastructure at platform scale.

  • Predictive demand and inventory across the supplier network.

  • Internal tooling that multiplies the output of every team.

Before you read further

HelloPrint is on a mission to become the world's leading infrastructure for customizable printed products. From our offices in Rotterdam and Valencia, 100+ professionals from 20+ nationalities are building an AI-first company that scales output faster than headcount. We're at EUR 100M revenue and aiming to disrupt a trillion-dollar industry. Every hire we make needs to help get us there.

  • Commercial instinct first, engineering second. You think about what something is worth before you think about how to build it.

  • Full-time in Rotterdam. Five days a week, in the building where the transformation is happening.

  • You have been building since before it was a career. Side projects, tools, systems nobody asked for. The obsession came first.

  • You ship continuously. You ship fast and you ship real systems. Not prototypes, not demos.

  • You are more than just an engineer. You understand product decisions, user impact, and design tradeoffs. You do not need a PM to translate the business problem for you.


Who you are:

You've built and shipped real production systems, not just contributed to someone else's. You're comfortable with ambiguity and don't need a fully specified brief to start. You care about what your work is worth, not just whether it works. You want to build inside a company that's already proven, not another 0-to-1 bet. You do not think of yourself as an AI engineer. You think of yourself as someone who solves hard problems and builds the systems to prove it. The engineering is the method. The obsession is the identity.

Three signals that tell us you are that person:

  • You've spotted an opportunity for an AI solution before anyone assigned it to you, and built it, even if it started as a side project or a shortcut nobody asked for. Ask you to name one and it won't take you long.

  • What you've shipped has been in production and actually used, not a prototype sitting in a repo or a demo that impressed someone once.

  • You can point to at least one thing you built where you had a rough idea of what it was worth before building it, and checked afterward whether it delivered.

Must-haves:

  • Hands-on production experience, not purely architectural or supervisory.

  • Commercial instinct that precedes technical execution: you know the business case before you write the first line.

  • Track record of shipping production AI/software systems that are live and used by real users.

  • Solid fluency in LLMs, agentic workflows, and modern AI infrastructure.

  • Ability to reason about commercial impact, not just technical correctness.

  • Comfortable working with high autonomy and limited process.

  • Office-first: on-site in Rotterdam, five days a week.



This role is not for you if you:

This role is not for people who got into AI because it became important. It is for people who have been building since before anyone called it a career. The kind of person who coded as a teenager, shipped their first thing before anyone asked, and has never really stopped. title: AI Engineer l Young Talent Program
description:
The rules of building are being rewritten. Come write them with us.

Every few decades, the way companies are built gets reinvented from scratch. That is happening right now, and the people who learn to build in this new world first will define the next twenty years. Superstars are being made this year, not in ten.

HelloPrint is a €100M+ e-commerce company serving businesses across Europe and the US. We are rebuilding the entire company as AI-first: our platform, customer service, operations, and how we design, price, sell, and deliver. Every piece of technology we run is being rewritten as we speak.


We are doing it with a small, senior, very fast AI development team working shoulder to shoulder with our business leads. Now we are opening a handful of seats for young builders who want to grow faster than any graduate scheme, bootcamp, or big-tech ladder could ever let them.


We don't care if you are 16, 25 or 30, whether you are self-taught, hacking in high school, or finishing a degree at TU Delft or TU/e—we care about what you have built and how fast you solve hard problems.

The HelloPrint AI Residency is how you start. It is a permanent role from day one: your first year is a structured residency where you rotate across our most important AI projects, build alongside the team and learn at full speed. After that, you keep growing - in the direction where you have the most impact.

What you will actually do:

You will not get a training plan, a sandbox project or six months of shadowing. From week one, you build real things that real customers and colleagues use, on the projects that matter most to the company. You sit next to the founders, next to the engineers who are rebuilding our platform, and next to the business leads who own the outcomes. You get a lot of freedom and real responsibility, plus honest, direct guidance and feedback from people who have built this before.

The kind of work you could be on in your first months:

  • Agentic Commerce: making HelloPrint discoverable and orderable through AI assistants, so a customer can order business cards from inside a chat.

  • AI Design Studio: letting customers create a print-ready design from a single sentence.

  • AI-first customer service: replacing classic ticketing with agents that resolve questions, check artwork and handle orders end to end.

  • Internal agent swarms: automating finance, purchasing, pricing and operations work that today still takes people hours.

  • Whatever you spot next: if you see something we should build, you pitch it, and if it is good, you build it.

We work with almost every modern framework and model, and we change our tools the moment something better appears. You will ship, measure, throw away and ship again - every week.


Who you are:

  • You are a builder before anything else. You have shipped things nobody asked you to build: an app, an agent, a bot, a tool your friends actually use, a side business, an open-source contribution, a weird experiment that taught you something. You probably have more GitHub commits, demos or deployed projects than most people twice your age.

  • You are extremely curious and extremely critical. You read the new model release the day it drops and try it that evening. You question every assumption, including ours, and you can explain why. You are never satisfied with "it works" — you want to know why it works, and how it could be ten times better.

  • You want to get better every single day, and you treat feedback as fuel rather than criticism. You take ownership: when something breaks, you fix it; when something is unclear, you go and find out.

  • You have a solid grasp of backend and software fundamentals (Python, APIs, databases) or the raw learning capacity to pick them up in weeks.

You will probably recognise yourself in most of this:

  • You build with AI every day: Claude, Cursor, Lovable, agents, APIs, whatever gets you there fastest.

  • You can show us concrete proof of work, not just tell us about it.

  • You move fast without being sloppy, and you care about the details the customer sees.

  • You are comfortable not knowing the answer, and you find it quickly.

  • You communicate clearly in English, in writing and out loud.


What we do not require: a degree, a minimum age, years of experience or a perfect CV. If you are still in school or university, we will make it work around that.

What you get:

The honest pitch: you will learn more here in one year than in five years almost anywhere else, because you will be building real systems for a real company that is reinventing itself, with the people who are leading that change.


A contract from day one. The Residency is your first year at HelloPrint, not a trial period or an internship.

  • Direct access to the founders and to a senior AI development team who review your work and push you.

  • Ownership from day one: your name on projects that change how a €100M+ company runs.

  • The best tools, no budget debates: the newest models, coding agents and frameworks, as soon as they are worth using.

  • A growth path that follows your output, not your age: if you outgrow your role in six months, your role grows with you.

  • A fast, flat, no-politics team in Rotterdam, with a hands-on culture and a high bar.

  • Flexible set-up: full-time, or part-time alongside your studies. We care about what you deliver.

Salary and contract are tailored to your situation and your level, and we pay properly for real talent.

How to apply:

Skip the cover letter. Show us what you have built.

Send us three things:

  1. Your best project: a link to something you built: a live product, a repo, a demo video. Tell us in a few sentences what it does and what you would do differently now.

  2. Something you think is broken: one thing about HelloPrint (our website, our ordering flow, anything) that you would rebuild with AI, and how you would do it.

  3. A short intro: who you are and what you are obsessed with right now. Five sentences is plenty.

What happens next:

  1. We read every application ourselves and reply within 5 days if you’re up to the next round

  2. A 15-minute call with one of our builders or founders about your projects.

  3. A Builders Day in our office: Together with other builders, you meet the team and if we have a click, you work on an assignment

  4. A conversation with the founders, and a decision the same day.

We would rather hear from you too early than too late. If you are not sure you are ready, apply anyway;  your work will answer that question for us. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds.

title: Account Executive  - DACH
description:
About the Role

We're building the sales engine for Tellent HR in the DACH market, and we're looking for an Account Executive to help us do it. Think of it as joining a startup inside a scale-up.

First and foremost, this is a hands-on selling role. You'll own the full sales cycle for Tellent HR (Manage and/or Grow), split roughly 80/20 between new business and expansion into our existing customer base. Inbound isn't going to be your main pipeline driver, so expect to spend around 50% of your time prospecting, against ambitious daily and weekly activity targets. Alongside that, you'll help us work out how we win in DACH: testing motions fast and doubling down on what drives revenue.

You'll work with a dedicated Product Marketing Manager and Customer Success Manager in the Tellent HR squad. CS capacity is limited, though, so you'll run deals independently, including demos and follow-through.

Your 12-Month Journey

  • First 3 months: Learn Tellent HR, our ideal customers and the competitive landscape in DACH. Build your first pipeline through outbound, establish a consistent daily activity rhythm, and close your first deals.

  • Within 6 months: Consistently hit your activity, pipeline and revenue targets, understand which sales motions work best in the DACH market, and feed insights back to Product Marketing and Product.

  • After 1 year: Be the go-to expert on selling Tellent HR in DACH, with a repeatable, data-backed playbook that others can pick up.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Own the full sales cycle, independently: Run 1–3 month, multi-stakeholder deals involving HR leaders, founders/CEOs and Finance, from first touch through to close and follow-through.

  • Hunt for new pipeline (around 50% of your time): Prospect by phone, email and LinkedIn, consistently hit your daily and weekly activity targets, and maintain 3–4x pipeline coverage. Partner, CS and marketing leads are a bonus, not the plan.

  • Drive expansion: Prospect into existing Tellent customers to cross-sell and upsell, e.g. Recruitee customers adding Tellent HR, or Manage customers adding Grow.

  • Sell on value: Run consultative discovery and tailored demos, position on business outcomes, and handle objections, including against key competitors (with support from PMM).

  • Manage deals with discipline: Use mutual action plans, keep HubSpot accurate (including SPICED), forecast reliably and disqualify early.

  • Test and build, alongside selling: Experiment with sales motions, sequences and verticals, help build the playbook with our PMM, and bring customer and competitive insights from the DACH market back to Product and Marketing.

What You Bring

  • Early-stage DNA: You've sold in a startup or early scale-up and built pipeline and processes where none existed. You know what it means to be an early sales hire.

  • Proven hunter: A track record of self-generating pipeline through outbound and consistently hitting ambitious activity targets. You genuinely enjoy picking up the phone and creating opportunities from scratch.

  • B2B SaaS sales experience: You've closed new business (ideally expansion too) as a fully autonomous AE in a startup or early scale-up, running 1–5 month, multi-stakeholder sales cycles. HR tech experience is a plus, not essential.

  • Self-sufficient and resilient: You don't wait for leads, support teams or perfect processes. You bounce back from rejection and stay disciplined through the ups and downs of building something new.

  • Consultative and data-driven: Strong discovery, demo and negotiation skills. You anchor on value before price and know your numbers (pipeline, conversion, win rate and cycle time).

  • Languages: Fluent English and native or fluent German are required. You'll be responsible for engaging customers and building relationships across the DACH market.

This role probably isn't for you if you want a structured environment with large support teams and steady inbound, or you're more excited by GTM strategy than by picking up the phone every day.

How We Measure Success

  • Closed-won revenue against target (primary KPI)

  • Daily and weekly outbound activity targets (key leading indicator, especially early on)

  • Self-generated pipeline and coverage

  • Win rate, deal velocity and forecast accuracy

  • Contributions to the playbook

What We Offer

  • Compensation: €55000–€70000 gross annual base salary, plus commission.

  • Ownership and impact: Real autonomy to shape the sales motion, playbook and market strategy for a growing product line.

  • Hybrid working: Work from our canal-side Amsterdam office 2–3 days per week.

  • International environment: Join a diverse and international team working across multiple markets.

  • Learning & Development: €1,500 annual learning budget and 2 dedicated learning days.

  • Pension & Wellness: Pension plan and wellness perks.

  • Time Off: 28 paid holiday days, plus 2 additional days in 2026.

  • Work from Anywhere: Work from anywhere for up to 4 weeks per year.

  • Commuting: Commuting and travel reimbursement.

  • Home Office: €200 home office budget and a work-from-home allowance.

  • Equipment: Apple MacBook and all the tools you need to succeed.

About Tellent

Tellent is a leading Talent Management Suite designed to empower HR & People teams across the entire employee journey. Our all-in-one platform combines an Applicant Tracking System (Tellent Recruitee), an intuitive HRIS (Tellent HR), and powerful Performance Management software (Tellent Grow).

With 250+ team members globally, 7,000+ customers in 100+ countries, and a growing ecosystem of 500+ partners, we help organizations attract, grow, and retain top talent — and we're just getting started.

title: Lead Java Software Engineer (v/m/x)
description:
Bouw mee aan de digitale toekomst van de openbare ruimte

Bij Progresity ontwikkelen we software die gemeenten helpt om de openbare ruimte slimmer, veiliger en duurzamer te beheren. Onze applicatie BinnenBeter verbindt inwoners en gemeenten: via de BuitenBeter app kunnen inwoners eenvoudig meldingen doen van problemen in de openbare ruimte, van kapotte straatverlichting tot zwerfafval of een losliggende stoeptegel. Gemeenten ontvangen deze meldingen in BinnenBeter en kunnen ze efficiënt opvolgen, zodat elke melding leidt tot een zichtbare verbetering in de leefomgeving. Zo zorgen we samen voor schonere, veiligere en beter onderhouden steden voor miljoenen inwoners in Nederland.

We staan aan de vooravond van een belangrijke volgende stap. Niet alleen ontwikkelen we onze software verder, ook professionaliseren we de manier waarop we software bouwen. We willen groeien naar een moderne engineeringorganisatie waarin eigenaarschap, kwaliteit, automatisering en continu verbeteren centraal staan.

Daarom zoeken we een Lead Software Engineer (Java) die niet alleen technisch sterk is, maar ook energie krijgt van het verder brengen van een engineeringteam. Iemand die verder kijkt dan de code van vandaag, een duidelijke technische visie kan ontwikkelen en anderen weet mee te nemen in verandering. Die begrijpt dat goede software niet alleen draait om technologie, maar ook om samenwerking, vakmanschap en het maken van de juiste keuzes.

Jouw rol

Als Lead Software Engineer (Java) combineer je hands-on software engineering met technisch leiderschap. Je werkt binnen een multidisciplinair productteam aan de verdere ontwikkeling van BinnenBeter en neemt het voortouw in de technische richting en professionalisering van Engineering.

Je bent eigenaar van de technische visie en architectuur van het product. Je bepaalt samen met je collega's hoe we onze software toekomstbestendig houden en vertaalt technische ambities naar concrete verbeteringen. Daarbij kijk je verder dan nieuwe functionaliteiten: ook onderhoudbaarheid, schaalbaarheid, security, betrouwbaarheid en technische schuld krijgen structureel aandacht.

Tegelijkertijd ben je een belangrijke kartrekker in het verbeteren van onze manier van werken. Hoe kunnen we sneller en betrouwbaarder releasen? Hoe maken we geautomatiseerd testen en CI/CD vanzelfsprekend? Hoe zorgen we dat engineers verantwoordelijkheid nemen voor hun software, ook nadat deze in productie staat?

Je hoeft deze uitdagingen niet alleen op te lossen. Je coacht Software Engineers, stimuleert eigenaarschap en zorgt dat technische kennis en verantwoordelijkheden niet bij één persoon blijven liggen.

Je gaat onder andere aan de slag met:

  • Het ontwikkelen, uitdragen en bewaken van de technische visie en softwarearchitectuur van BinnenBeter.

  • Het ontwerpen en ontwikkelen van robuuste, onderhoudbare en schaalbare software met Java en Spring Boot.

  • Het richting geven aan belangrijke technische keuzes en het ontwikkelen en borgen van engineeringstandaarden en architectuurprincipes.

  • Het vertalen van relevante wet- en regelgeving en beveiligingseisen naar concrete technische richtlijnen.

  • Het verbeteren van onze engineeringpraktijken, waaronder CI/CD, testautomatisering, observability en DevOps.

  • Het inzichtelijk maken en structureel aanpakken van technische schuld, kwetsbaarheden en andere technische risico's.

  • Het ontwikkelen en realiseren van een technische verbeteragenda, samen met het engineeringteam.

  • Het coachen van Software Engineers en stimuleren van zelfstandigheid, kennisdeling en technisch eigenaarschap.

  • Het versterken van de samenwerking tussen Engineering, Product, UX, Quality en Cloud/Platform.

  • Het onderzoeken van nieuwe technologieën en werkwijzen, waaronder AI, die onze software of manier van ontwikkelen daadwerkelijk beter maken.


Wat neem je mee?

We zoeken een ervaren Software Engineer die inhoudelijk sterk is, maar ook begrijpt dat technisch leiderschap meer vraagt dan het maken van goede technische keuzes.

 

Je kunt complexe vraagstukken analyseren en een duidelijke richting bepalen. Tegelijkertijd weet je anderen daarin mee te nemen, sta je open voor andere perspectieven en haal je voldoening uit het ontwikkelen van collega's.

 

Wat we belangrijk vinden:

  • Ruime ervaring met Java en Spring Boot en een sterke achtergrond in professionele software engineering.

  • Ervaring met softwarearchitectuur, REST API's en het ontwerpen van onderhoudbare en schaalbare applicaties.

  • Je kunt complexe technische vraagstukken doorgronden, alternatieven afwegen en onderbouwde technische keuzes maken.

  • Je hebt ervaring met het ontwikkelen of verbeteren van technische standaarden, architectuurprincipes en engineeringpraktijken.

  • Je hebt kennis van moderne softwareontwikkeling, waaronder CI/CD, geautomatiseerd testen, security en observability.

  • Je hebt ervaring met het begeleiden of coachen van andere Software Engineers en vindt het leuk om collega's technisch verder te helpen.

  • Je communiceert helder, kunt technische onderwerpen begrijpelijk uitleggen en weet verschillende disciplines met elkaar te verbinden.

  • Je neemt initiatief, durft verantwoordelijkheid te nemen en weet ideeën om te zetten in concrete verbeteringen.

  • Je bent pragmatisch en kunt een goede balans vinden tussen technische kwaliteit, ontwikkelsnelheid en klantwaarde.

  • Je bent beschikbaar voor 32, 36 of 40 uur per week.

 

Mooi meegenomen, maar geen vereiste:

  • Ervaring met Angular en TypeScript.

  • Ervaring met WildFly, Azure, Docker, Kubernetes of vergelijkbare technologieën.

  • Ervaring met het begeleiden van technische veranderingen of het professionaliseren van een engineeringteam.

  • Ervaring met cloud-native architecturen, DevOps en het beheren van software in productie.

 

Je hoeft niet eerder de functietitel Lead Software Engineer te hebben gehad. Misschien ben je nu Senior Software Engineer of Software Architect en merk je dat je steeds vaker technische richting geeft, collega's begeleidt en verbeteringen initieert. Als je klaar bent om daarin een volgende stap te zetten, gaan we graag met je in gesprek.

 

Dan bieden wij jou

  • Een salaris tussen €4.500,- en €6.690,- bruto per maand (o.b.v. 40 uur), afhankelijk van jouw ervaring.

  • Een rol waarin je daadwerkelijk invloed hebt op de technische richting van onze software en de ontwikkeling van Engineering.

  • Veel ruimte voor eigen initiatief, technische verbeteringen en het toepassen van nieuwe technologieën.

  • Hybride werken met flexibele werktijden en een modern kantoor in Capelle aan den IJssel.

  • Werken in een team waar jouw ideeën daadwerkelijk worden gehoord.

  • 8% vakantiegeld.

  • 25 vakantiedagen met de mogelijkheid om 5 extra dagen bij te kopen.

  • Laptop van de zaak.

  • Goede pensioenregeling en collectieve bonus.

  • Een jaarcontract met uitzicht op een vast dienstverband.

  • Een rol waarin jouw werk iedere dag maatschappelijke impact heeft.

 

Over Progresity

Progresity is onderdeel van de Conxillium Group. Samen ontwikkelen we slimme software voor gemeenten. Onze producten ondersteunen gemeenten bij het beheren van de openbare ruimte: van bomen en groenvoorzieningen tot wegen, verlichting en meldingen van inwoners.

We bevinden ons in een interessante fase. We groeien van een traditionele softwareorganisatie naar productgerichte teams waarin eigenaarschap, samenwerking en continu verbeteren centraal staan. Dat betekent dat developers bij ons niet alleen meedenken over hoe we software bouwen, maar ook over waarom we iets bouwen en welke waarde dat oplevert voor onze gebruikers.

Je komt terecht in een hecht team waarin vakmanschap, nieuwsgierigheid en elkaar helpen belangrijker zijn dan hiërarchie. We geloven dat de beste ideeën ontstaan wanneer mensen verantwoordelijkheid krijgen en samen blijven leren.

Lees meer over onze organisatie op: www.progresity.com.

Sollicitatieproces

Ons sollicitatieproces bestaat meestal uit drie gesprekken. We vinden het belangrijk dat we elkaar goed leren kennen. Naast jouw technische kennis zijn we vooral benieuwd hoe jij samenwerkt, hoe je naar softwareontwikkeling kijkt en hoe jij jezelf én een team verder helpt groeien.

title: Agent Security Engineer
description:
Belmont Lavan is hiring an Agent Security Engineer to secure autonomous AI agents before and after they reach production. Agents now call tools, hold credentials and act on live systems, so they need the controls we already expect for people and services: identity, least-privilege access, monitoring and testing.

You will sit between AI engineering and security. You will design the guardrails, attack the systems yourself, and build the governance controls that let the business deploy agents with confidence.

Requirements

  • 5+ years in security engineering (AppSec, cloud security, IAM or offensive security), with at least 1 year securing LLM or agent-based systems
  • Hands-on knowledge of LLM attack techniques: prompt injection, jailbreaks, data exfiltration via tools, RAG poisoning
  • Experience designing identity and access controls: OAuth 2.0 / OIDC, token exchange, workload identity, secrets management
  • Working knowledge of agent frameworks and protocols such as LangGraph, OpenAI Agents SDK, CrewAI or Model Context Protocol (MCP)
  • Strong coding skills in Python, plus one of Go, TypeScript or Rust
  • Cloud security on AWS, Azure or GCP, including logging, detection and policy-as-code (e.g. OPA / Cedar)
  • Ability to explain AI risk clearly to engineers, risk teams and executives

title: Senior Influencer Marketing Project Manager
Head of Product Experience
description:
At Vio, we believe booking accommodation should feel fair and effortless, never overwhelming or unclear.

As one of the world's fastest-growing travel tech platforms, we help millions of travelers find and book the right stay at the right price. They can book with us directly, compare offers across 100+ booking sites, or book through partners who offer our experience under their own brand.

Our goal is to help travelers book like an insider. That means cutting through the noise and complexity of hotel booking and surfacing real value with clarity, transparency, and full support. No tricks. No confusion. Just great stays, booked with confidence.

With operations in 100+ markets and growing fast, our mission is to reshape how people discover and book accommodation through technology that travelers can trust.

🔍 Who we're looking for

We're looking for a senior design leader to own Vio's whole user experience: Product Design, UX Research and Content Design, and the product outcomes they serve. You'll lead a team of around ten across design, research and content. This is a chance to build a function, not inherit one.

You'll report to our Head of Product and sit in domain leadership alongside product, engineering and commercial leaders, shaping strategy from the start. Vio runs two businesses on one platform: our consumer product, and white-label and API products for partners. Your job is to make the experience across both recognisably world-class, and to build a team that can sustain it.

☑️ What you'll do

  • Set the UX vision for Vio's next chapter, and bring product, engineering and commercial partners along with it.

  • Own user-facing outcomes with your peers, and make design's contribution measurable.

  • Lead Product Design, UX Research and Content Design, and design the org that brings them together in your first 90 days.

  • Set and hold the craft bar: run critique and product reviews, and make journeys consistent across our products and brands.

  • Work with Product and Engineering on how we ship, not only what we ship: bring design into problem framing early, and raise the quality of what reaches our users.

  • Build a team people want to join and stay in: clear ownership, air cover, real growth paths, and recognition for great work.

  • Stay close to the work, with ring-fenced time on north-star concepts and cross-product journeys.

  • Make AI part of how design, research and content work.

  • Give design a stronger voice inside Vio and a visible presence outside it.

🔎 Who you are

  • You've led a multi-discipline UX organisation (design and design systems, research, content) at scale, including leaders of leaders, with real depth across all three, including research.

  • You frame the problem before the solution, make trade-offs between user and commercial needs, and can show the outcomes and metrics you've moved with Product.

  • You're a credible peer to senior product, engineering and business leaders, and you influence beyond design.

  • You've designed B2B2C products, where partners offer the product to their own customers and judge it as well as end users.

  • Your own craft holds up at the highest level: you lead critique, set the quality bar in the details, and articulate a vision that others rally behind.

  • You build teams that grow, and you hire people stronger than yourself.

  • You use AI in your own practice and know how to scale it across a team.

Nice to have: travel, marketplace or OTA experience; multi-brand or white-label design systems; a visible external profile through talks, writing or case studies.

❓ Why join us now?

  • You'll build Vio's design function and shape its UX from a seat in domain leadership, at a pivotal moment for the company.

  • We're one of the fastest-growing accommodation booking platforms in the world today, having grown our bookings 30x between 2017 and 2025, and catering to the needs of millions of travelers each year.

  • In 2026, we underwent a company-wide rebrand and launched our first StoryTelling marketing campaign in the UK, establishing Vio as a consumer-facing, creative brand.

  • Our mobile apps (iOS and Android) have reached 5 million installs with strong customer reviews.

  • We reward our employees for the value they create by granting Stock Appreciation Rights to all employees.

➕ What we offer

  • Plenty of chances to learn and grow within an open, diverse culture that promotes knowledge sharing, trust, and transparency.

  • A great compensation package, perks, and benefits - including significant stock appreciation rights.

  • Flexible time off, with as many holidays as you need, and a chance to work remotely.

  • You'll be part of an international team in one of the best office locations in Amsterdam.

  • We value good food and offer catered lunches from various cuisines, great coffee, and the occasional barbecue in our garden.

  • We enjoy getting together to celebrate our wins, with company events in Amsterdam and abroad.

  • A budget for your home office.

  • Access to free mental health support via OpenUp.

We encourage people from all ethnic groups, genders, sexualities, ages, and abilities to apply. If this job description resonates with you, we'd love to hear from you.

Location: Amsterdam or remote within CET ±1 (some flexibility up to CET ±3 for exceptional candidates), with travel to our Amsterdam office around six times a year.

title: Projectmanager Datacenters
description:
Krijg jij energie van het leiden van grote en complexe projecten waarin techniek, samenwerking en commercie samenkomen? Weet jij multidisciplinaire teams mee te nemen en houd je tegelijkertijd grip op kwaliteit, planning, budget en klantbelang? Als Projectmanager Datacenters bij Deerns neem jij de regie over uitdagende advies- en ontwerpprojecten binnen een sector die continu in ontwikkeling is.

 

De uitdaging 

Als Projectmanager Datacenters ben je verantwoordelijk voor het succesvol realiseren van grote en complexe projecten binnen de datacentersector. Je stuurt multidisciplinaire projectteams aan en zorgt ervoor dat projecten binnen de afgesproken kwaliteit, planning en financiële kaders worden gerealiseerd.

Daarbij combineer je projectmanagement met technische inhoud. Je begrijpt wat er binnen de verschillende technische disciplines speelt en weet de juiste specialisten met elkaar te verbinden. Je hoeft niet zelf ieder technisch detail uit te werken, maar bent inhoudelijk sterk genoeg om keuzes te beoordelen, risico's te herkennen en richting te geven aan het project.

De datacenterwereld stelt hoge eisen aan onder andere betrouwbaarheid, energie-efficiëntie en veiligheid. Binnen Deerns werken we aan uiteenlopende projecten, van de ontwikkeling van nieuwe datacenters tot uitbreiding, verduurzaming en renovatie van bestaande locaties.

Je bent daarbij niet alleen verantwoordelijk voor het project zelf. Ook de samenwerking met de opdrachtgever, het financiële resultaat en het herkennen van nieuwe kansen behoren tot jouw rol.

 

Tot je verantwoordelijkheden behoren: 

  • Het leiden en aansturen van multidisciplinaire projectteams;

  • Het bewaken van kwaliteit, planning, budget, scope en projectresultaat;

  • Het opstellen en bewaken van projectplannen, planningen, begrotingen en voorstellen;

  • Het organiseren en leiden van kick-offs, project- en coördinatieoverleggen;

  • Het tijdig signaleren van risico’s en afwijkingen en hierop gericht bijsturen;

  • Het afstemmen met opdrachtgevers, architecten, aannemers, installateurs en andere projectpartners;

  • Het onderhouden en verder uitbouwen van duurzame klantrelaties;

  • Het signaleren van commerciële kansen en het bespreken van meerwerk en aanvullende opdrachten;

  • Het bewaken van de financiële voortgang en bijdragen aan een gezonde projectmarge;

  • Het bijdragen aan het verbeteren van projectprocessen en onze manier van samenwerken.

 

Het team en de projecten

Je wordt onderdeel van een hecht en multidisciplinair team met een gedeelde passie voor datacentertechnologie en duurzame techniek. Binnen het team komen verschillende expertises samen, waaronder werktuigbouwkunde, elektrotechniek, brandveiligheid en duurzaamheid. Kennisdeling, samenwerking en werkplezier staan centraal.

Je werkt aan nationale en internationale projecten voor uiteenlopende opdrachtgevers binnen de datacenterbranche. Daarbij krijg je te maken met complexe technische vraagstukken en verschillende stakeholders. Geen project is hetzelfde en juist die combinatie van techniek, organisatie en samenwerking maakt deze functie uitdagend.

Door jouw ervaring speel je daarnaast een belangrijke rol in de verdere ontwikkeling van het team. Je deelt kennis, begeleidt minder ervaren collega’s en helpt ons om onze projecten steeds slimmer en efficiënter te organiseren.
 
Dit ben jij 

Je bent een ervaren projectmanager die techniek, mensen en commercie met elkaar weet te verbinden. Ook wanneer projecten complex worden, behoud je het overzicht en weet je de juiste prioriteiten te stellen. Je durft beslissingen te nemen, communiceert gemakkelijk op verschillende niveaus en creëert duidelijkheid voor zowel de opdrachtgever als jouw projectteam.

Je geeft mensen de ruimte om vanuit hun eigen expertise bij te dragen, maar bent duidelijk wanneer richting of besluitvorming nodig is. Tegelijkertijd kijk je verder dan het project van vandaag: je begrijpt het belang van duurzame klantrelaties en herkent kansen om onze samenwerking met opdrachtgevers verder uit te bouwen.

Verder beschik je over:

  • Hbo- of wo-werk- en denkniveau, bij voorkeur met een technische achtergrond;

  • Ruime ervaring binnen complexe technische ontwerp- en/of adviesprojecten;

  • Bij voorkeur circa 15 jaar relevante werkervaring, waarvan een belangrijk deel in projectleiding of projectmanagement;

  • Brede multidisciplinaire technische kennis;

  • Ervaring met het aansturen, motiveren en coachen van projectteams;

  • Kennis van projectmanagementmethodieken, planning en financiële projectbeheersing;

  • Kennis van relevante contractuele en bouwrechtelijke aspecten;

  • Commercieel inzicht en ervaring met klant- en stakeholdermanagement;

  • Een resultaatgerichte en oplossingsgerichte manier van werken.

 

Dit bieden wij 

  • Een bruto maandsalaris tussen € 5.623 en € 8.033 (op basis van 40 uur per week), afhankelijk van jouw ervaring, kennis en expertise.

  • Een functie van 32-40 uur per week.

  • Uitdagende projecten voor toonaangevende opdrachtgevers in Nederland en internationaal. 

  • Een werkomgeving waarin innovatie en duurzaamheid dagelijks in de praktijk worden gebracht. 

  • Aandacht voor jouw eigen ontwikkeling en vitaliteit met ruime opleidings- en ontwikkelingsmogelijkheden, fiets- en sportregelingen, flexibele werkuren, 33 vakantiedagen en mogelijkheid tot aankopen van extra dagen. 

  • Hybride werken, waarbij je de mogelijkheid hebt om afwisselend thuis en op kantoor in Den Haag te werken. 

  • Een team waar samenwerking en collegialiteit voorop staan en waar we informeel met elkaar omgaan. 

  • Duurzaamheid zit in onze genen. Dit uit zich bijvoorbeeld in een mobiliteitsbeleid waar gezondheid en duurzaamheid voorop staan. Veel van onze kantoren liggen bij OV-knooppunten, fietsen wordt aangemoedigd en je reiskosten worden 100% vergoed op basis van OV. 

 

Over Deerns 
Deerns is als onafhankelijk ingenieursbureau gespecialiseerd in advies, ontwerp en uitvoeringsbegeleiding op het vlak van installatietechniek, bouwfysica, energievoorziening en duurzaamheid. Onze expertises dragen bij aan duurzame, intelligente en toekomstbestendige gebouwen die de processen van onze opdrachtgevers optimaal ondersteunen. We zijn verantwoordelijk voor het ontwerp van de installaties en het realiseren van een goed comfort en een prettig klimaat in de meest uiteenlopende gebouwen; van kantoren, tot luchthavens en van ziekenhuizen tot datacenters. 

 
Daarnaast is Deerns benoemd als Great Place to Work!

title: Stage Sales Backoffice
description:

Je bent binnen de backoffice echt een spin in het web: je hebt contact met verschillende afdelingen zoals sales, logistiek, finance en klantenservice. Daarnaast krijg je de mogelijkheid om tijdens je stage 1 à 2 dagen mee te kijken op andere afdelingen.
